message.content: {"8": {"original": "MPAA sued BitTorrent and Usenet sites without prior notice, sparking outrage", "rephrased": "The Motion Picture Association of America initiated legal action against BitTorrent and Usenet platforms without first notifying the site administrators, a procedural failure that has generated significant anger among the operators of these services.", "summary": "The MPAA sued BitTorrent and Usenet sites without prior notice, sparking outrage."}, "9": {"original": "We feel that should the MPAA deem us illegal then they must also target premium", "rephrased": "The administrators of the Descds service argue that if the Motion Picture Association of America determines their platform illegal, the organization must also pursue legal action against premium paid Usenet providers, which currently act as the transit for these files without facing similar lawsuits.", "summary": "Descds administrators argue the MPAA must also target premium Usenet providers if they deem the service illegal."}, "10": {"original": "We also find it ironic still that Newzbin, creators, instigators and promoters", "rephrased": "The operators of the Descds service express frustration that Newzbin, the creators and promoters of the NZB format and arguably the largest Usenet indexing site in the world, have not yet been targeted by the Motion Picture Association of America, leading them to feel they are being unfairly rushed into legal proceedings.", "summary": "Descds operators find it ironic that the largest Usenet indexing site has not been sued by the MPAA."}, "11": {"original": "Descds, despite being outside US jurisdiction, is happy to assist the MPAA", "rephrased": "Although the Descds service operates outside of United States jurisdiction, its administrators state they are willing to cooperate with the Motion Picture Association of America to resolve the dispute, provided the organization first engages in direct communication rather than proceeding immediately with legal action.", "summary": "Descds administrators are willing to assist the MPAA despite being outside US jurisdiction."}}
